verdict.rationale: Clara documents its own MCP integration for when a user wants an AI assistant to inspect or act on Clara data in natural language. Documented actions include listing cards, reviewing transactions, switching companies and locking a card, and the agent guidance includes confirmation safeguards for money-moving Pix payments. Missing for 10: detailed MCP setup and tool-list documentation, a native in-app natural-language command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Use Clara MCP when the user wants an AI assistant to inspect or act on Clara data in natural language, such as listing cards, reviewing transactions, switching companies, or locking a card
Always confirm the destination, amount, and date with the user before creating a Pix payment (`POST /api/v3/accounts-payable/pix`) — it moves money.
